title: Added tasks never show up in the ListView
summary: A QAbstractListModel append gets wrapped in beginInsertRows and endInsertRows, and done goes into roleNames. last is inclusive, so subtract one.

turns.user: showing tasks in a QML ListView. addTask doesnt add anything on screen, but if i go to another page and back its there. also done is undefined

assistant.body: Let's go through it step by step. addTask appends to tasks_ directly, so nothing tells the view a row arrived. Call beginInsertRows before the change and endInsertRows after it, and rowsInserted reaches the ListView, which then builds a delegate for just that row. done is undefined because DoneRole is missing from roleNames, and QML can only reach the roles named there. While at it, a list model returns 0 rows for a valid parent, and data runs checkIndex first. More robust that way.

turns.user: also want to bulk import like 100 rows from CSV. addTask in a loop fires 100 notifications right?

assistant.body: Right. addTasks inserts them all under one beginInsertRows. An empty list cannot form a range, so it returns early. Add the declaration to the header too.

turns.user: added QAbstractItemModelTester and the import crashes. Actual (model->rowCount(parent)) 3, Expected 4 or something

assistant.body: Apologies, that was my mistake. The last argument of beginInsertRows is inclusive, so n rows end at first + n - 1. My code announced one row too many, and the tester caught the mismatch at endInsertRows. Key point: first and last both name row numbers as they will be after the insert.

turns.user: works. want a checkbox to toggle done, something QML can call

assistant.body: Here's toggleDone. Declare it with Q_INVOKABLE in the header. After the value changes it emits dataChanged with only DoneRole as the third argument, so the view does not read title again. With that, both new rows and changed values reach the view.
